noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

trainingPeriod.description:
The duration of time a baseline model is trained upon. Data _must_ be available
for this entire period for training to occur.

Examples: '365d', '2y', '104w'

trainingInterval.description: The interval of data a baseline model is trained and evaluated upon.

invalidationThreshold.description: The minimum percentage of data invalidation to warrant a re-training.

featureMetrics.description: The list of metrics to use as input to baseline training/evaluation.
